critical_code_review_comments: FieldNoteDetailPage.js is ~1400+ lines containing all NOTES content as a single in-file object. For future maintainability, consider splitting per-slug content into /data/field-notes/*.js modules and importing — keeps the page component focused on rendering and avoids re-bundling all notes on every detail-page visit.

Review request mentioned data-testid 'city-lead-z-project-9' and 'city-faq-z-project-9' as if they were static, but implementation uses dynamic 'city-lead-{city}' and 'city-faq-{city}'. The dynamic naming is correct (uniqueness per page); the request copy was misleading. No code change needed.
